cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor:/workspace/submission timeout 300 python3 -c "
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import planner
from gen2 import gen_case
rng = random.Random(0)
case = gen_case(rng, 64, 32, 8, 4)
# instrument
orig_a = planner._block_a; orig_b = planner._block_b
stats = {'a':0,'b':0,'iters':0,'cur':0,'hist':[]}
def a(net, cap):
    stats['a'] += 1; stats['iters'] += 1
    return orig_a(net, cap)
def b(net, cap):
    stats['b'] += 1
    n = len(net.wdist)
    before = list(net.wdist)
    r = orig_b(net, cap)
    cnt = sum(1 for x,y in zip(before, net.wdist) if y < x)
    stats['hist'].append(cnt)
    return r
planner._block_a = a; planner._block_b = b
res = planner.solve_epoch(case)
print('augmentations ~', stats['a'], 'b calls', stats['b'])
h = stats['hist']
print('total b', len(h), 'sum improvements', sum(h), 'max', max(h))
print('first 60', h[:60])
" 2>&1 | tail -8
